page.notes: Ornaments (hand-like marks) stand before several entries and are not printed text. "Alimenta in diuersis": the scan shows a ligature, read as "in". "Aera": the word may be "Aer a", read as "Aera" with doubt. "Amuletum" is read from "Amulerum" with [?]. "vbiq" is followed by a small superscript mark, probably the abbreviation for "vbique", kept as printed. The running head "INDEX" has a small decorative mark at its end; the page number is not printed. Stains and a red seal at lower left are not printed.
